name: Load Kernel Modules
description: Load kernel modules on the Proxmox host that an unprivileged container cannot load itself. kernel_modules lists them (space-separated); explicitly listed modules are persisted in /etc/modules-load.d/proxvex.conf. Without kernel_modules the Docker set (overlay, ip_tables, ip6_tables, bridge, br_netfilter) is loaded until the next reboot.

commands.description: Load the modules from kernel_modules (default: the Docker set)
